obfuscation_indicators: inability to quantify certain comparative metrics
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, including sales bridges, margin impacts, impairment charges, restructuring costs, and liquidity metrics. Risk tone is mildly negative because operating margin declined, oil and gas assets were impaired, restructuring occurred, and industrial indicators weakened, although revenue and earnings still grew. The text includes substantial technical and accounting boilerplate and acknowledges limits on product-mix and volume comparisons.
